reason: This changes executor spill/restore behavior for hash aggregation and also touches core `pkg/util/chunk` disk-format and memory-tracking code. Spill paths are runtime-correctness sensitive: bugs can cause wrong query results, corrupted restored rows, OOM/mis-accounting, or failures only under memory pressure. Even though the executor entrypoint is narrow, the changed utility layer is central enough and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for High-severity correctness issues.
